title: This $5 Habit Is Stealing $1,825 From You Every Year

scenes.heading: STOP!
lines: Stop. You're losing almost two thousand dollars a year, and you don't even feel it.

scenes.heading: It's not rent...
lines: And no, it's not your rent. It's not your car.

lines: But five dollars a day is eighteen hundred and twenty five dollars a year!

scenes.heading: That's a vacation
lines: That's a vacation. That's an emergency fund. That's real breathing room.

lines: So here's the move. Tomorrow, skip it once, and send that five dollars straight to savings.
